The analysis is complete. I am now preparing the final summary of findings.

The component is `s3presign.Runner` in `/bench/repo/server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`.

It refreshes presigned S3 URLs for external attachments. It skips attachments whose current URL remains valid for the next four days. Otherwise it generates new five-day presigned URLs and updates the attachment's `Reference` field.

The runner runs every twelve hours via `time.Ticker` using `runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`.
